$comment: CPEs that scripts/audit.sh adds to binary-scope conda artifacts before grype runs.
syft derives CPEs from conda package names (e.g. cpe:2.3:a:libstdcxx-devel_linux-64:...), which
name no NVD product, so the statically linked libstdc++.a / libgcc.a would never match a CVE.
These two packages ARE gcc's runtime libraries at gcc's version, so they are matched as gnu:gcc.
{version} is replaced with the artifact's version. Every key must be in audit/binary-packages.txt.
Deliberately NOT mapped: sysroot_linux-64 -> glibc (the binary links only glibc's crt objects and
libc_nonshared.a; libc.so itself comes from the user's host, so glibc 2.28's CVEs would be noise),
clang-23 / compiler-rt23 (builtin headers only), kernel-headers_linux-64 (UAPI headers only).
